seed 1102
== item spawn
> Ann: item spawn 10001
Ann: You wave your hands around and <ansi fg="item">sharp stick</ansi> appears from thin air and falls to the ground.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> waves their hands around and <ansi fg="item">sharp stick</ansi> appears from thin air and falls to the ground.
== mob spawn rat
> Ann: mob spawn rat
Ann: You wave your hands around and <ansi fg="mobname">rat</ansi> appears in the air and falls to the ground.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> waves their hands around and <ansi fg="mobname">rat</ansi> appears in the air and falls to the ground.
